The MACD line has just slipped below its signal line, producing a slightly negative histogram reading of -0.91, a classic bearish crossover signal suggesting bullish momentum is losing its grip. ETH Price Ethereum analysis reveals a market at an inflection point. The $1,850 support zone continues to defend against deeper pullbacks, and the rising OBV suggests accumulation is underway.
